theme: The Week 8 plan, in the Hub — crockpots, one-pots & Friday pizza bagels

items.name: Crockpot BBQ Pulled Chicken Sliders
ingredients: 2 lb boneless chicken breasts or thighs
steps: Layer onion, chicken and BBQ sauce in the crockpot with the garlic powder; cook LOW 4-5 hrs.
Shred the chicken in the pot and stir through the sauce.
Toss the coleslaw mix with mayo, vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Pile chicken on slider buns; top with slaw and pickle chips.
items.tip: The slaw on top is the whole ballgame — make it while the chicken cooks.
items.note: Sunday crockpot — shred it in the pot, slaw goes on top.

items.name: One-Pot Creamy Sausage Tortellini
steps: Brown sausage with onion and bell pepper 6-7 min; drain.
Add garlic, tomatoes, broth and seasoning; bring to a boil.
Simmer tortellini 4-5 min until tender.
Stir in cream, wilt in the spinach, shower with Parmesan.
items.tip: The spinach wilts down to almost nothing — use the whole bag.
items.note: One pot, 25 minutes — spinach wilts in at the very end.

items.name: Quick Ham & Cheese Strombolis
steps: Saute pepper, onion and spinach until just wilted; cool a couple of minutes.
Layer ham, provolone and vegetables down the middle of the dough; fold and pinch shut, seam-side down.
Egg wash, Italian seasoning on top, 3 slits.
Bake 425F 14-16 min; rest 5 min and slice. Serve with warm marinara and the salad.
items.tip: Let the sauteed filling cool a couple of minutes so the dough doesn't go soggy.
items.note: Tuesday quick fix — deli ham and cheese, rolled and baked.

items.name: Crockpot Black Bean & Sweet Potato Chili
steps: Add everything except the toppings to the crockpot with 1 tsp salt.
Cook LOW 5-6 hrs (or HIGH 3 hrs), until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Set out cheddar and sour cream; everyone tops their own bowl.
items.tip: Meatless and proud of it — nobody misses the meat with the toppings bar.
items.note: Meatless crockpot — sweet potato and black beans carry it.

items.name: One-Pot Beef & Broccoli Lo Mein
steps: Brown the ground beef 6-7 min; drain.
Add garlic and ginger, then 3 cups water, beef broth, soy sauce and brown sugar; boil.
Simmer the dry noodles covered 6-7 min, stirring twice.
Stir in broccoli, carrots and bell pepper 3-4 min; finish with sesame oil and green onions.
items.tip: Spaghetti works fine if Aldi is out of lo mein noodles.
items.note: Takeout energy at home — broccoli and carrots in the noodles.

items.name: Quick Pizza Bagel Bar
steps: Lay bagel halves cut-side up on two sheet pans; heat oven to 425F.
Sauce each half to the edges.
Set out mozzarella, pepperoni, bell pepper, spinach and mushrooms bar-style.
Bake 8-10 min until bubbly and crisp at the edges.
items.tip: Sauce to the edge on every bagel — no dry bites.
items.note: Friday build-your-own — everybody tops their own bagels.

items.name: One-Pot Mild Chicken & Sausage Jambalaya
ingredients: 12 oz smoked sausage or kielbasa, coins
steps: Brown the sausage, then sear the chicken in the same pot; set both aside.
Soften onion, bell peppers and celery in the drippings; add garlic and all the mild spices.
Stir in rice, tomatoes, broth and corn; simmer covered 18-20 min, no peeking.
Fold the meats back in with the peas; rest 5 min, fluff, top with green onions.
items.tip: No peeking while the rice cooks — the steam is doing the work. Hot sauce at the table for the grown-ups.
items.note: Saturday one-pot — mild for the kids, peppers and celery in the base.

items.name: Black Bean & Corn Burritos
steps: Cook the rice.
Sauté a diced onion until soft.
Add drained beans and corn, plus half the salsa and a shake of cumin and chili powder. Heat through.
Warm the tortillas so they don’t crack.
Fill with rice, the bean mix, cheese, and sour cream; roll up.
items.tip: Optional: crisp the rolled burritos in a dry skillet until golden on each side.
items.note: Spare: a saved-for-later favorite — cheap, meatless, 25 minutes.

items.name: Honey Garlic Chicken Breast
steps: Thaw the chicken and cut it into bite-size pieces.
Sear in an oiled skillet for 5–6 minutes.
Stir together ⅓ cup honey, ¼ cup soy sauce, and 4 minced garlic cloves.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and simmer 5 minutes, until glossy.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli.
items.tip: Don’t overcook the breast — that’s the whole game.
items.note: Spare: the other saved-for-later favorite — glossy honey garlic over rice.
